Description: Authoring side of SpecQuiz: create weighted certifications with single-answer questions.

Summary: Create a certificate with title and pass percentage
Description: As an exam author, I want to create a certificate with a title and pass percentage, so that I can model a real certification exam.
Acceptance Criteria:
AC-001: WHEN an author submits a new certificate with a non-empty title and a valid pass percentage THE SYSTEM SHALL create the certificate and confirm it was created.
AC-002: IF an author submits a certificate with an empty or missing title THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL reject the request with a validation error and SHALL NOT create the certificate.
AC-003: IF an author submits a pass percentage that is not an integer between 1 and 100 THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL reject the request with a validation error.

Description: As an exam author, I want to add weighted sections to a certificate, choosing an existing section name or a new one, so that the exam mirrors the real exam's domains.
Acceptance Criteria:
AC-004: WHEN an author adds a section to a certificate THE SYSTEM SHALL let the author either select an existing section name or provide a new one.
AC-005: IF an author assigns a section weight that is not a positive multiple of 20 THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL reject the section with a validation error.
AC-006: IF the sum of all section weights is not exactly 100 THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL reject saving the certificate with a validation error identifying the current total.
AC-007: IF an author saves a certificate with no sections THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL reject it with a validation error requiring at least one section.

Description: As an exam author, I want to add a question with four options, one correct answer, and a one-line explanation, so that candidates can be tested.
Acceptance Criteria:
AC-008: WHEN an author adds a question with non-empty text, exactly four options, exactly one correct, and a one-line explanation THE SYSTEM SHALL add the question to that section's pool.
AC-009: IF a submitted question does not have exactly four options THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL reject it with a validation error.
AC-010: IF a submitted question has zero or more than one option marked correct THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL reject it with a validation error.
AC-011: IF a submitted question has empty text or a missing explanation THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL reject it with a validation error.

Description: As an exam author, I want to edit an existing question, so that I can keep the pool accurate.
Acceptance Criteria:
AC-012: WHEN an author saves valid edits to an existing question THE SYSTEM SHALL persist the update and reflect it immediately.
AC-013: IF an author edits a question into an invalid state THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL reject the edit and retain the previous valid version.
AC-014: IF an author edits a question that does not exist THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL respond with a not-found error.

Description: As an exam author, I want to delete a question, so that I can remove outdated content.
Acceptance Criteria:
AC-015: WHEN an author deletes an existing question THE SYSTEM SHALL remove it and confirm the deletion.
AC-016: IF an author deletes a question that does not exist THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL respond with a not-found error.

Description: As an exam author, I want to set how many questions an attempt serves, so that the practice exam matches the intended length.
Acceptance Criteria:
AC-017: IF an author sets the number of questions to ask below 5 THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL reject it with a validation error.
AC-018: IF the configured number of questions exceeds the pool size THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL reject saving with a validation error.
AC-019: THE SYSTEM SHALL select served questions proportionally to each section's weight.

Description: As a training program owner, I want invalid certificates rejected, so that candidates only see well-formed exams.
Acceptance Criteria:
AC-020: IF a certificate has fewer than 5 questions in total THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL reject saving it with a validation error.
AC-021: IF a certificate violates any validity rule THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL report every violated rule in the validation response.

Description: As an exam author, I want to set a pass percentage, so that attempt results can be judged pass or fail.
Acceptance Criteria: AC-022: WHEN an author sets a pass percentage between 1 and 100 THE SYSTEM SHALL store it against the certificate for scoring attempts.

Description: As a training program owner, I want realistic sample certifications available immediately, so that the tool is usable without manual data entry.
Acceptance Criteria:
AC-023: WHEN the application starts THE SYSTEM SHALL load at least two sample certifications, each with >=1 section and >=5 questions, weights summing to 100.
AC-024: THE SYSTEM SHALL ensure every bootstrapped certification satisfies all certificate validity rules.

Description: As an exam author, I want to view existing certificates and their questions, so that I can review and maintain them.
Acceptance Criteria:
AC-025: WHEN an author opens the Certification Management page THE SYSTEM SHALL display existing certificates with sections and question counts.
AC-026: WHEN an author opens a certificate THE SYSTEM SHALL display its sections, weights, pass percentage, exam length, and questions.
